NEON DRIVE

Echo Mini simulator · runs the real ReChord firmware UI ·
ECHO · SIM
Booting…
Things to try
  • Search: MUSIC → Search. VOL spins the letter, PLAY adds it, BACK deletes. Hold PLAY (or spin to GO>) for results.
  • A-Z jump: open any long list (Music → Artists, or All Songs) and hold PLAY.
  • Power off: hold POWER for the diagonal "virus" shutdown; press POWER again to watch the shop-shutter boot.
  • Music: Playlists (Favorites, your .m3u8 lists, and every music folder), All Songs, Artists, Search, Organize.
  • Battery ad: watch the main tower: every other 10 s a dumb ad shows the battery %.
  • Long titles scroll on Now Playing. MENU adds Cover art and a Sleep timer.
  • EQ presets: SETTINGS → Equalizer: Bass Boost, Vocal Boost, Synthwave and more, plus a 10-slider custom curve.
  • Volume runner: play a song, then tap VOL+ / VOL− on Now Playing.
  • Other themes: SETTINGS → Interface → Theme.
  • Keyboard: ↑/↓ volume keys, Enter PLAY (hold for A-Z), Backspace BACK, M MENU.

The screen is drawn by ReChord's own code compiled to WebAssembly — the same screens, theme engine and library index that run on the player. Only the hardware is pretend: there's no audio, and songs "play" on a timer.
